apps.title: Apps
apps.description: App Store numeric ids or URLs, and Google Play package ids or URLs. All digits or an apps.apple.com URL is treated as App Store; anything else as Google Play.

language.title: Language
language.description: Google Play review language (ignored for the App Store).

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Per app and country. The App Store RSS feed caps at 500 newest reviews per country.

classify.title: Add classification columns
classify.description: Run every review through jev and add the typed columns.

questions.title: Custom questions
questions.description: Optional jev question schema replacing the preset. Up to 50 questions of type noul, choice (criteria = {label: description}) or score (criteria = list of descriptions, low end first).

confidenceThreshold.title: Confidence threshold
confidenceThreshold.description: Rows with any choice/score confidence below this get review_needed: true.
